name: A Company of Your Own
jem_summary: Have three entries in your mount collection, earn the taming and breeding achievements, and bind a supported pet to a home.

pages.title: A Company of Your Own
pages.text: Have three entries in your mount collection, earn the taming and breeding achievements, and bind a supported pet to a home.

pages.title: A Company of Your Own
pages.text: Bring care, new life, transport and a safe home together as an optional chapter finale.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Tame three different eligible mount types, for example a horse, donkey and llama. Merely mounting does not add records; command/spawn-egg creatures and Creative taming are excluded. Bind one supported pet to its home; no pet death is required.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: The collection records native taming of eligible mount types, not merely riding, and persists in singleplayer.
